## rnd-v10 â€” Build session summary (grounded in EXECUTION-LOG.md)

Built Anchor R&D Surface v10 "Live Handoff & Boneyard" across 8 waves on branch `foreman/rnd-surface-v10` (off master `b33c74a`); **all 8 waves GREEN, PROJECT DONE**, final gate **1189 passed, 1 skipped**.

**W1 â€” paste-NOT-submit substrate:** `start_session(paste_prompt=)` records `pending_paste`; `_flush_pending_paste` writes it to the PTY *unsent*, once, after the greet. New registry fields `pending_paste`/`paste_flushed` (commit verified `terminal_session.py:547-575`).

**W2 â€” both-artifact advance:** `handoff.build_next_stage_prompt` + `write_next_prompt`â†’`NEXT-PROMPT.md`; advance paths deliver the prompt as a pending paste instead of an auto-submitted seed. John signed off the screenshot 2026-06-17 (commit `453f687`).

**W3 â€” grass two toggleable terminals:** split the shared grass host into per-lane research+plan `.gterm` hosts, each independently collapsible (collapse keeps the session live). Per-lane Save (commit `9594d89`).
**W4 â€” grass archive + lineage:** `archive_grass_session` + `session_registry.grass_origin` stamped/inherited to the chain root; board-tile "from grass" chip; idempotent archive (commit `bcbd3ca`).

**W5 â€” grass researchâ†’plan live handoff:** `advance_grass_research_to_plan` (contained `(idea,'plan')` session, linked, paste-pending; honest-negative without a real research doc) + `queue_paste` deliver-on-focus (commit `e506859`).

**W6 â€” NEW `boneyard.py`:** per-project index (`record_entry`/`list_entries`/`search`/`get_entry`), capture wired on kill/delete/grass-delete (index-not-copy, references v8-persisted rels); added to `dist_manifest.txt` (commit `bc0397e`).
**W7 â€” Boneyard UI:** `GET /api/rnd/boneyard`, "â˜  Boneyard" tab with search; all doc links route through traversal-safe `/artifact` (commit `6c1c2ab`).

**W1 BLOCKER:** premature paste flush â€” greet marker was a substring of the echoed seed; fixed by counting marker occurrences *beyond* the seed (`base = seed_text.count(marker)`). Also closed a double-paste TOCTOU via compare-and-set under `WRITE_LOCK` and newline-strip.

**W2 North-Star hole:** `finish_to_build` marked planning DONE without `kill` â†’ docs unpersisted â†’ build checkout could lack the paths `NEXT-PROMPT.md` cited; fixed with `capture_session_docs` (persist+commit, no reap) before advancing.
**W3 BLOCKER:** `saveGrassRefinement` referenced an undeclared `panel` â†’ ReferenceError on every Save (no test clicked Save); restored container lookup + made Save per-lane.

**W6 MAJOR:** deleting a *live* session recorded two boneyard entries (killed + deleted); fixed via `kill(_record_boneyard=False)` from `delete_session` â†’ exactly one `deleted` entry. **W6 HIGH:** `build_grass_entry` omitted W4 archive-bundle docs â†’ unioned `list_grass_archives`.
**W7 HIGH/security (stored-XSS):** client live-search `_esc` escaped `& < >` but not `"` â†’ attribute breakout; hardened shared `_esc` to full HTML-escape, regression-tested on both render paths.

Recurring **WS/SSE teardown flakiness** (`WinError 10053/10054`, "closed file" ValueError) was hardened systemically: production `_is_benign_disconnect` returns cleanly on client disconnect; `tests/conftest.py` autouse harness swallows only benign daemon-thread teardown exceptions. Verified deterministic across repeated stress runs.
